message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Fresh sweep completed for the 24-hour daily run ending 2026-06-09 05:10 IST, using the monitored product list in Products.txt. One credible, product-matched issue was found: SolarWinds Serv-U CVE-2026-28318, with fresh June 8 reporting that CISA-confirmed exploitation is underway.

**Finding 1: SolarWinds Serv-U unauthenticated denial-of-service vulnerability reported as exploited**

- Product: SolarWinds Serv-U
- Issue: CVE-2026-28318
- Severity: High / CVSS 7.5, as stated by SolarWinds via NVD
- Description: SolarWinds Serv-U can be crashed by specially crafted unauthenticated POST requests using `Content-Encoding: deflate`, causing a denial-of-service condition. Fresh June 8 reporting says CISA confirmed active exploitation and added the issue to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
- Why it appears relevant: The monitored list includes SolarWinds. Serv-U is a SolarWinds managed file transfer / FTP server product, so this maps to the monitored SolarWinds product family even though Serv-U is not listed separately.
- Sources: NVD CVE record: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-28318; Help Net Security: https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/06/08/cisa-patch-actively-exploited-solarwinds-serv-u-dos-vulnerability-cve-2026-28318/

**Reviewed but excluded**

- Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager CVE-2026-20245: credible, but the monitored Cisco scope is Cisco Nexus, Cisco UCS, and Cisco Fabric Extender; the advisory did not map to those products.
- Python, pip, Ansible, Notepad++, Adobe Acrobat, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, OpenSSL, Chrome, Firefox, Ubuntu, SonicWall, Fortinet, and other searched products: no credible in-window finding both matched the monitored product list and passed freshness checks.
- WordPress ecosystem plugin reports: items found in fresh feeds either predated this 24-hour window or involved plugins not named in the monitored list, so they were not included as confirmed findings.

Closing note: Immediate review is recommended if SolarWinds Serv-U is deployed, especially if internet-exposed. No other fresh, credible, product-matched vulnerabilities were confirmed for the monitored list in this daily window.
